title: Siegard specification frontmatter
description: Frontmatter contract for a specification in foundation/, the repository's authority for behavior. The body format and the section vocabulary are enforced by scripts/validate_specs.py; the status vocabulary is defined in docs/concepts/accepted.md and shared with schemas/adr.json and schemas/concept.json. A specification carries no supersession relation: `superseded_by` was removed on 2026-07-31 by maintainer decision, so a retired specification states its replacement in prose rather than in a field a validator resolves.

id.description: Four-digit sequential id, never reused, matching the filename prefix. Must be a quoted string: YAML reads an unquoted 0010 as octal 8 and an unquoted 0008 as a string, so the unquoted form is neither safe nor type-stable.

title.description: What the specification governs, stated as an outcome.

status.description: Lifecycle vocabulary; `docs/concepts/accepted.md` fixes what each value means. Only a maintainer, or a deterministic approval mechanism this repository defines, may change this value away from proposed. A proposed specification carries no normative weight and binds nothing.

contract_version.description: A consumer rejects an artifact it was not built to read rather than inferring version from shape.
